runtime_boundaries_identified: Electron main process: in-process plugin runner via FileSystemLoader `import()` of the manifest entrypoint (fs.ts)
Renderer BrowserWindows: per-window Eventa contexts via `createContext(ipcMain, window)` and `setupBaseWindowElectronInvokes`
Plugin iframe UI: sandboxed iframe (manifest `iframe.sandbox`) served through a loopback HTTP static-asset service with cookie-backed session auth and path/symlink checks
External process lifecycle: Godot stage via `node:child_process` spawn; MCP servers via `StdioClientTransport` (stdio subprocess)
Server channel: WebSocket server whose start/stop/restart is embedded in the main-process app lifecycle (appHooks)
plugin-sdk Node/Web runtime transports: in-memory implemented; websocket/node-worker/electron/web-worker throw 'not implemented'
server-sdk WebSocketExtensionPeer: a separate, functional server-sdk protocol client, distinct from the unimplemented plugin-sdk runtime transport

documentation_drift.claim: AGENTS.md lists `crates/` as the legacy Tauri desktop platform for this repository.
documentation_drift.documentation_evidence: AGENTS.md: 'Legacy: `crates/` (old Tauri desktop; current desktop is Electron).'
documentation_drift.implementation_evidence: The checkout contains no `crates/` directory and no Cargo.toml (Glob `crates/*` and `crates/**` return no files); `apps/stage-tamagotchi/package.json` uses electron-vite/electron-builder.

rationale: The answer is a read-only architecture review of the AIRI Electron desktop app (stage-tamagotchi). I verified its core claims against implementation: injeca composition root wires server channel/Godot/MCP/plugin host/window managers (main/index.ts:154-270); FileSystemLoader does `await import(entrypoint)` (fs.ts:74), so plugins run in the main-process JS runtime; node/web runtimes throw "not implemented" for websocket/node-worker/electron/web-worker transports while only in-memory works (node/index.ts:24-38, web/index.ts); server-manager does serial start, reverse shutdown, and mutex guard (server-manager/index.ts); static assets use loopback host, cookie session auth, path-traversal and realpath/symlink checks (static-assets/index.ts, paths.ts); reload is stop-then-fresh-start with new session identity (core.ts:842-857); Godot is spawned and MCP uses the stdio client transport; server channel has start/stop/restart embedded in appHooks lifecycle and supports LAN binding (channel-server/index.ts). Line citations land on the right files (a few off by a few lines, still in the right region). The named test baselines exist. No material or minor factual errors were found; the review correctly distinguishes intent (plugin-sdk README, declared transport types) from current capability (in-memory only) and correctly treats Electron as the current desktop platform. The single repository drift note (legacy crates/ Tauri absent from checkout) is non-decision-relevant and historical. All nine dimensions are fully satisfied: repository classification, path/symbol evidence with intent-vs-current distinction, concrete friction (main-process fault domain, setMaxListeners(0), per-window IPC duplication), explicit quality-attribute trade-offs, three viable options including status quo, a recommendation that follows from the evidence, incremental/reversible migration phases, concrete verification criteria, and no over-generalization. Total = 18/18 with the accuracy gate passing.
